Some of the most influential articles ever written

Published on May 22, 2023 by Erik Pillon

articles

1 min READ

  • The Age of Social Transformation, Peter Drucker (1994)
    Discusses the profound social changes brought about by the rise of the knowledge society.
    Field: Sociology, Management
    • Link to the article: pdf
  • The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Mathematics in the Natural Sciences, Eugene Wigner (1960)
    Explores the surprising effectiveness of mathematics in describing and predicting natural phenomena.
    Field: Mathematics, Physics
    • Link to the article: pdf
  • Is Google Making Us Stupid?, Nicholas Carr (2008)
    Examines the impact of internet usage, particularly search engines, on cognition and human thinking.
    Field: Technology, Psychology
    • Link to the article: pdf
  • A Theory of Human Motivation, Abraham Maslow (1943)
    Proposes the hierarchy of needs theory, outlining human motivation and self-actualization.
    Field: Psychology
    • Link to the article: pdf
  • Science and Complexity, Warren Weaver (1948)
    Explores the role of complexity and self-organization in various scientific disciplines, emphasizing biology.
    Field: Complex Systems, Biology
    • Link to the article: pdf
